result_excerpt:
#4201 Password reset email links to localhost
Opened by mkowalczyk on 2026-09-08

I clicked "Forgot password" on the login page. The email arrived within a
minute, but the link in it goes to

    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

which of course doesn't load for me. Two people on my team

name: read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email uses a base URL derived from the environment variable PUBLIC_URL, falling back to "http://localhost:3000" if not set. This default causes the reset link in the email to point to localhost when PUBLIC_URL isn't configured properly in the deployment environment. To fix this, ensure that the PUBLIC_URL environment variable is set to the production URL of the service so that the password reset link is correct for users.
